license_required.quote: Persons entitled to practice optometry in Kansas shall be those persons licensed in accordance with the provisions of the optometry law.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the board of examiners in optometry established under K.S.A. 74-1501

name.quote: "Board" means the board of examiners in optometry established under K.S.A. 74-1501

type.quote: "Board" means the board of examiners in optometry established under K.S.A. 74-1501

moral_character_required.quote: Who is of good moral character; and in determining the moral character of any such person, the board may take into consideration any felony conviction of such person

degree_required.value: Graduation from a school or college of optometry approved by the board
degree_required.quote: who has graduated from a school or college of optometry approved by the board

accrediting_body.quote: The board shall adopt rules and regulations establishing the criteria which a school or college of optometry shall satisfy in meeting the requirement of approval by the board

exams.name: Board examination
exams.notes: Examination in subjects taught in approved schools or colleges of optometry
exams.quote: who successfully meets and completes the requirements set by the board and passes an examination given by the board

exams.name: Kansas law examination
exams.quote: successfully passes an examination of Kansas law administered by the board and such clinical practice examination as the board deems necessary

interval_years.quote: Any license to practice optometry issued by the board shall expire on May 31 of the year specified by the board for the expiration of the license and shall be renewed on a biennial basis

required.quote: each licensee applying for license renewal shall furnish to the secretary of the board satisfactory evidence of successfully completing a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education annually

hours_per_period.quote: a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education annually

period_years.quote: a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education annually

value: therapeutics or related topics of study
topical_requirements.quote: five hours of which shall relate to ocular pharmacology, therapeutics or related topics of study, approved by the board

available.quote: Any applicant for reciprocal licensure may in the board's discretion be licensed and issued a license without examination if the applicant has been in the active practice of optometry in another state for at least the three-year period immediately preceding the application for reciprocal licensure

requirements.value: Active practice in another state for at least 3 years; certified copy of license from equivalent state; sworn statement that license has never been limited, suspended or revoked; pass Kansas law examination; pay reciprocal license fee
requirements.quote: has been in the active practice of optometry in another state for at least the three-year period immediately preceding the application for reciprocal licensure

regulatory_model.quote: Persons entitled to practice optometry in Kansas shall be those persons licensed in accordance with the provisions of the optometry law.

credential_type.quote: if such person complies with the other qualifications for licensing and passes such examination, such person shall receive from the board, upon the payment of a fee fixed by the board by rules and regulations in an amount of not to exceed $150, a license entitling such person to practice optometry

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who violates any of the provisions of this act shall be guilty of a class C misdemeanor for the first offense

title_protection.quote: a person shall be deemed to be practicing optometry within the meaning of the optometry law if such person in any manner: (1) Holds oneself out to the public as being engaged in or who maintains an office for the practice of optometry

scope_protection.quote: Persons entitled to practice optometry in Kansas shall be those persons licensed in accordance with the provisions of the optometry law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or securing an original or renewal license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has committed fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or securing an original or renewal license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of an act of unprofessional conduct or professional incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has committed an act of unprofessional conduct or professional incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been convicted of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraudulent or false advertisements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has used fraudulent or false advertisements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violation of the optometry law, pharmacy act, or uniform controlled substances act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has willfully or repeatedly violated the optometry law, the pharmacy act of the state of Kansas or the uniform controlled substances act, or any rules and regulations adopted pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of an order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated an order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay renewal fees specified in the act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to pay renewal fees specified in this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with annual continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to comply with the annual continuing education requirements as required by this act and the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of optometry under a false or assumed name, or impersonation of another practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has engaged in the practice of optometry under a false or assumed name, or the impersonation of another practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to perform optometry with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, alcoholism, drug use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has the inability to perform optometry practice acts with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, alcoholism, excessive use of drugs, controlled substances, chemical or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: License revoked, suspended, limited, or other disciplinary action taken in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has had a license to practice optometry revoked, suspended or limited, has been censured or has had other disciplinary action taken, or an application for a license denied, by the proper licensing authority of another state, territory, District of Columbia, or other country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any lawful rules and regulations or orders of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated any lawful rules and regulations promulgated by the board or violated any lawful order or directive of the board previously entered by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the validity of the examination for a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has cheated on or attempted to subvert the validity of the examination for a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found to be mentally ill, disabled, not guilty by reason of insanity, or incompetent to stand trial by a court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been found to be mentally ill, disabled, not guilty by reason of insanity, not guilty because the licensee suffers from a mental disease or defect or incompetent to stand trial by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated a federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the board or its investigators any information legally requested
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to furnish the board, or its investigators or representatives, any information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sanctions or disciplinary actions taken by a peer review committee, health care facility, or professional association
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sanctions or disciplinary actions have been taken against the licensee by a peer review committee, health care facility or a professional association or society for acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct which would constitute grounds for disciplinary action under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report to the board any adverse action taken against the licensee by another state, licensing jurisdiction, peer review body, or other entity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board any adverse action taken against the licensee by another state or licensing jurisdiction, a peer review body, a health care facility, a professional association or society, a governmental agency, by a law enforcement agency or a court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrender of a license or authorization to practice in another state while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has surrendered a license or authorization to practice optometry in another state or jurisdiction or has surrendered the licensee's membership on any professional staff or in any professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report to the board the surrender of a license or authorization in another jurisdiction while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board surrender of the licensee's license or authorization to practice optometry in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adverse judgment, award or settlement resulting from a medical liability claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has an adverse judgment, award or settlement against the licensee resulting from a medical liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct which would constitute grounds for disciplinary action under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report to the board any adverse judgment, settlement or award from a malpractice liability claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board any adverse judgment, settlement or award against the licensee resulting from a malpractice liability claim

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain a policy of professional liability insurance as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to maintain a policy of professional liability insurance as required by K.S.A. 40-3402 or 40-3403a, and amendments thereto, or pay the annual premium as required by K.S.A. 40-3404

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly submitting misleading, deceptive, false or fraudulent representation on a claim form, bill or statement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has knowingly submitted any misleading, deceptive, false or fraudulent representation on a claim form bill or statement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide to a patient their written prescription for lenses for eyeglasses after completion of the eye examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to provide to a patient the patient's written prescription for lenses for eyeglasses subsequent to the completion of the eye examination in accordance with applicable state or federal law.

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry means: (1) The examination of the human eye and its adnexae and the employment of objective or subjective means or methods (including the administering, prescribing or dispensing, of topical pharmaceutical drugs) for the purpose of diagnosing the refractive, muscular, or pathological condition thereof; (2) the prescribing, dispensing or adapting of lenses...; and (3) the prescribing, administering or dispensing of topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs for the examination, diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions and any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexae including adult open-angle glaucoma.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of optometry means: (1) The examination of the human eye and its adnexae and the employment of objective or subjective means or methods (including the administering, prescribing or dispensing, of topical pharmaceutical drugs) for the purpose of diagnosing the refractive, muscular, or pathological condition thereof

value: examination of the human eye and its adnexae
objective or subjective means or methods
administering, prescribing or dispensing topical pharmaceutical drugs
prescribing, dispensing or adapting lenses, prisms, low vision rehabilitation services, orthoptic exercises and visual training therapy
prescribing, administering or dispensing oral drugs for ocular conditions including adult open-angle glaucoma
methods_authorized.quote: the prescribing, administering or dispensing of topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs for the examination, diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions and any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexae including adult open-angle glaucoma

drug_authority.value: Topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs (including oral antibacterial, antiviral, antihistamines, analgesics, steroids, antiglaucoma drugs and other oral drugs with clinically accepted ocular uses) for examination, diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions
drug_authority.quote: the prescribing, administering or dispensing of topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs for the examination, diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions and any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexae including adult open-angle glaucoma

surgery_prohibited.quote: The practice of optometry shall not include: ... (2) the performance of surgery, including the use of lasers for surgical purposes

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: except that licensees may remove non-perforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva or eyelids

value: remove non-perforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva or eyelids
scrape the cornea for diagnostic tests, smears or cultures
dilate, probe, irrigate or close by punctal plug the tear drainage structures of the eye
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: licensees may remove non-perforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva or eyelids; remove eyelashes; scrape the cornea for diagnostic tests, smears or cultures; dilate, probe, irrigate or close by punctal plug the tear drainage structures of the eye; express conjunctival follicles or cysts; debridement of the corneal epithelium and co-management of post-operative care

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: the prescribing, administering or dispensing of topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs for the examination, diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions and any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexae including adult open-angle glaucoma

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: the prescribing, dispensing or adapting of lenses (including any ophthalmic lenses which are classified as drugs by any law of the United States or of this state), prisms, low vision rehabilitation services, orthoptic exercises and visual training therapy for the relief of any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexae

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: the prescribing, administering or dispensing of topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs for the examination, diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: The examination procedures performed by assistants to optometrists or ophthalmologists shall be limited to data gathering at the direct request of the ophthalmologist or optometrist and to those examination procedures which do not require professional interpretation or professional judgment.

maximum_number_of_offices.quote: A licensee shall not be limited in the number of locations from which the licensee may engage in the practice of optometry

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: No contact lens prescription may be limited by an expiration date or otherwise to a period of less than 12 months from either the date the prescription is first determined or the last date of the contact lens evaluation

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: The licensee has failed to provide to a patient the patient's written prescription for lenses for eyeglasses subsequent to the completion of the eye examination in accordance with applicable state or federal law.

jurisprudence_exam_required.quote: successfully passes an examination of Kansas law administered by the board

criminal_background_check_required.quote: The board may require an applicant for licensure or a licensee in connection with an investigation of the licensee to be fingerprinted and submit to a state and national criminal history record check
